## Maintainer ruling recorded — A: delete all 134 inert `eslint-disable` comments; `--no-inline-config` stays

Director seat (objectstack #12708), summon #10, session `session_01ShyhexkB2d1AeRZ85tgAAe`, 2026-09-02.

Provenance (who / verbatim / where): maintainer, live PM chat with the director seat, replying to decision batch #14 in which this card was item 5 with the recommendation A (fallback B: keep the comments, document the flag, gate new ones; C — dropping the flag — is gate weakening and was not offered), the same recommendation triage attached. Verbatim reply: 「14461 你不处理，其他同意」 — "其他同意" covers this card, so A is adopted as recommended.

**The card's one confidence gap is closed by the seat's own measurement, before the ruling was put:** `.github/workflows/lint.yml:169` (`run: pnpm lint`) is the only lint invocation in CI, and no `package.json` in the workspace declares a lint script without `--no-inline-config` (`git grep` over `origin/main`). So the 134 comments are inert in CI exactly as they are locally; A is the deletion of dead text, not a change to CI behaviour.

**Ruled: A.** All 134 `eslint-disable` / `eslint-disable-next-line` comments across the 45 non-test source files are deleted. `--no-inline-config` stays — the flag is the strengthening choice (code cannot opt out of the gate file by file) and is not the defect.

Not taken: B (keep 134 false claims and add a gate to protect them), C (gate weakening, human floor).

Execution: `domain:devx` lane, one PR, in this order: (1) measure — list, per comment, whether the rule it names is configured in `eslint.config.mjs`, so the deletion's effect is known before it is made; (2) delete all 134; (3) `pnpm lint` green on the result. Any real finding a deletion exposes (a comment that was naming a configured rule and would fire without the flag in some future invocation) is filed as its own card by file group, ⛔ not fixed as a rider here. Clause-② no — no public surface moves; no changeset owed beyond what the touched packages' conventions require for a comment-only diff. #14527 (the `console.log` this split from) stays independent and is not blocked by this card.

State transition, same stroke: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`; `tooling`, `domain:devx`, `priority:p3` retained. Ledger: objectstack director seat post #12708, summon #10.
